title: Antonius Felix, Governor of Judea
lead: The Roman governor of Judea before whom Paul was tried at Caesarea (Acts 23-24). Brother of Pallas, a favorite of Claudius whom Suetonius lists among the emperor's freedmen, he rose to govern Judea. He is also described by Josephus, Tacitus and Suetonius, and a wife named Drusilla appears in Acts and Josephus.
